feeds.title: Discalced Carmelite Friars Blog
feeds.description: The Discalced Carmelites are a Roman Catholic religious community of priests, brothers, nuns, and laity serving the Church through lives of prayer and ministry, in a fraternal setting. Our roots go back to twelfth-century hermits on Mount Carmel in the Holy Land.

feeds.title: Carmelite Sisters of the Most Sacred Heart of Los Angeles Blog
feeds.description: The way of life of the Carmelite Sisters of the Most Sacred Heart of Los Angeles is rooted in the Gospel, and in the Carmelite spirituality of St. Teresa of Avila. 'Carmel' means enclosed garden in which God Himself dwells. The divine indwelling in the soul is the foundation of Teresa's doctrine. Thus, our charism unites the contemplative nature of Carmel with active apostolic works in service of the Church.

feeds.title: Sisters of Carmel
feeds.description: Find out the latest news from the Sisters - both Website News & Community news. We are cloistered, contemplative Carmelite nuns. Our Carmelite life of prayer and sacrifice for God and neighbor depends on the charity of others.

feeds.title: Carmelites.ie
feeds.description: The Irish Province of the Brothers of Our Lady of Mount Carmel (the Carmelites) is a registered charity in Ireland.

feeds.title: Carmelite Institute of North America
feeds.description: The Carmelite Institute of North America is a collaborative effort of the Carmelites of the United States and Canada. Its mission is to promote the following of Jesus Christ through studies in the Carmelite tradition and by making the tradition available to our Carmelite brothers and sisters, as well as to all those interested in spiritual life.

feeds.title: Carmelite Missionaries
feeds.description: We the Carmelite Missionaries are founded by Fr. Francisco Palau, a Carmelite Priest from Spain in 1860. We are an international Congregation and thus we are present in forty countries all over the world. Our charism is to be sign of communion in the Church and in the world.

feeds.title: Discalced Carmelites News
feeds.description: The Discalced Carmel acknowledges Saint Teresa as its mother and foundress. It is the only Order which has a woman as its foundress and, distinct from the other Orders which have male and female branches, the nuns were established before the friars.

feeds.title: Order Of The Carmelites News
feeds.description: The Order of Carmelites, also known as the Order of the Brothers of the Most Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel is a thriving religious family dedicated to serving people as men and women of God. As one of the major mendicant religious orders in the Catholic Church, we have been following the Rule of St. Albert for the past 800 years!

feeds.title: The Secular Order of Discalced Carmelites (OCDS) in New Zealand
feeds.description: The latest news, events and retreats from the Secular Discalced Carmelites (OCDS) of New Zealand. The Secular Order of Discalced Carmelites (OCDS) is an integral part of the Carmelite family; its members are sons and daughters of the Order of Discalced Carmelites (OCD). We are truly Carmelites as the fathers, brothers, and nuns of the Order, sharing with them a common vocation of prayers and pursuit of holiness.

feeds.title: Carmelite Sisters of the Divine Heart of Jesus
feeds.description: The Carmelite Sisters of the Divine Heart of Jesus is an international Congregation with their General Motherhouse in Sittard, Netherlands. They seek to see, serve, and love God in the children, the aged, the poor, and the lonely.

feeds.title: Carmelite Monastery Blog
feeds.description: Through self-sacrifice, silence, penance and prayer, The Carmelites Sisters offer their very lives as a prayer to God for all humanity.

feeds.title: Carmelite Quotes Blog
feeds.description: Your source for Carmelite wisdom: we share quotes and media from Teresa of Avila, John of the Cross, Therese of Lisieux, and more.

feeds.title: Our Lady of Mt Carmel Blog
feeds.description: We the people of the Catholic Parish of Our Lady of Mount Carmel, inspired by the Gospels and charism of the Carmelite tradition and living in Resurrection hope, seek to fulfill our mission by partnering with Jesus in his mission of transforming the world. We do this by being a vibrant, worshipping community, seeking to deepen our spirituality

feeds.title: The Carmelite Centre Melbourne Blog
feeds.description: Our Mission is to leverage and build on the Carmelite tradition and bring the essence of this tradition of contemplation, service, and hospitality to the community through a range of spirituality based programs and experiences. The Carmelite tradition honors the individual embraces community and welcomes people who seek spirituality and personal enrichment.

feeds.title: Little Flower Basilica Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1926, Our Lady of Mount Carmel and St. Thérèse Parish was founded by a delegation of Discalced Carmelite Friars who sought refuge in the U.S. from the persecution of the Mexican Revolution. The first Eucharistic Celebration of the new parish took place in a makeshift chapel at the intersection of Kentucky & Zarzamora on April 4, 1926. From there the shrine and community continued to grow, even throughout the Great Depression.

feeds.title: Saint Therese of Lisieux: A Gateway
feeds.description: St. Therese of Lisieux, born Therese Martin, was a young French girl, passionately in love with Jesus Christ, who became a Discalced Carmelite nun at age fifteen and died of tuberculosis at age twenty-four in a monastery in Lisieux, France. Her liturgical name is 'St. Therese of the Child Jesus,' from her name as a religious. She has often been called 'St. Therese, the Little Flower.'

feeds.title: Vocation Blog » Carmelites
feeds.description: A blog about vocations to the consecrated life. The purpose of the Vocation Blog is to provide information and inspiration about the vocational call to consecrated life, whether it is as a religious sister, priest, brother, monk, or other consecrated person.

feeds.title: Discalced Carmelite Friars Blog
feeds.description: The Discalced Carmelite Friars are a community of men - priests and religious brothers - serving the Church through a life of contemplative prayer.

feeds.title: A Solitary Bird
feeds.description: I am a devout Roman Catholic, wife to a wonderful man for 34 years, mother of four terrific children, grandmother to four special kids, and a Secular Discalced Carmelite. I started this blog in order to share some thoughts about prayer and Carmelite spirituality. I love all the Carmelite saints and their writings, and I want to share what they have taught me as I try to live out their teachings and the Carmelite Rule.

feeds.title: Carmelite Monastery Notting Hill News
feeds.description: The mission of the Carmelite is to enter, by the total gift of herself, into the saving mission of Christ, who gave himself for us that we might come to a fuller life in God, and who said: Love one another as I have loved you.

feeds.title: Carmelite Nuns of Great Britain
feeds.description: The Carmelite Order began around the start of the 13th century, when a small group of Western pilgrims settled on Mt Carmel in Palestine. They lived a simple life of prayer and manual labour, and followed a 'rule' or 'formula for life' given to them by St Albert of Jerusalem.

feeds.title: CHRIST IS OUR LIFE
feeds.description: Congregation was founded by Venerable Mary Angeline Teresa to care for the aged and infirm in the spirit and tradition of the Carmelite Order. Follow us!

feeds.title: Carmelite Monastery of Baltimore Blog
feeds.description: We are Carmelite sisters embracing the mystical flame of contemplation through prayer, silence and solitude. Enter this sacred space and discover the fire of God's love.

feeds.title: The Carmelite Library
feeds.description: The Carmelite Library is a special theological library dedicated to study and research in the areas of Spirituality and Mysticism. The collection is unique within Australia. The Library is an affiliated member of the University of Divinity (UD) and a library of Yarra Theological Union. It is the Province Library of the Carmelite Friars in Australia-Timor Leste. The Library is housed in a spacious and handsome setting for study and reading purposes. Everyone is most welcome to visit the Library.

feeds.title: Carmel in the Desert
feeds.description: I'm Candida Kirkpatrick. Wife for 26 years and mother of two beautiful children, ages 22 & 19. Blessed member of St. Joseph's Secular Order Discalced Carmelites of Phoenix, AZ for 17 years. Earned Certification to teach Theology of the Body [TOB] from JPII Resource Institute in Diocese of Phoenix. Student at Center for Applied Carmelite Studies at Oxford Friary, Boars Hill.

feeds.title: Our Lady of Mercy
feeds.description: The Lay Carmelite Order of the Blessed Virgin Mary (historically known as the Third Order) is an association mainly of laypersons. Its members, responding to a special call of God, freely and deliberately commit themselves 'to live in the following of Jesus Christ' according to the charism, traditions and spirit of Carmel under the authority of the Prior General of the Carmelite Order.

feeds.title: Discalced Carmelites of Wolverhampton Blog
feeds.description: The Carmel of the Magnificat in Wolverhampton is a cloistered Roman Catholic community of Discalced Carmelite nuns, following the charism and lifestyle of St. Teresa of Avila, who reformed the Carmelite Order in the 16th century.

feeds.title: Carmel of St. Teresa of Jesus Blog
feeds.description: Our Carmel is a small monastery located in Little Rock, Arkansas on 22 acres of wooded land. Our greatest joy is to labor in the vineyard of the Lord as those who offer lives of prayer in many forms throughout the day on behalf of the Church and the world.

feeds.title: Carmelite Order
feeds.description: Carmelite Order (O. Carm) is a Catholic religious Order based in Rome with communities and ministries around the world.

feeds.title: Carmelite Sisters of Ireland Blog
feeds.description: We are Discalced Carmelite Nuns of the Order of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel. We are a worldwide Order or Religious Family with approximately eleven thousand nuns on all continents. We live a cloistered contemplative life, following in the footsteps of St. Teresa of Avila, Spain.

feeds.title: Our Lady of Mount Carmel Fairfield News
feeds.description: Our Lady of Mount Carmel Parish community is administered by the Carmelites and guided by the Bishop of the Diocese of Sacramento.Our mission is to create the opportunities and atmosphere for meaningful worship, sound teaching, spiritual growth, faith formation, and an active witnessing of the Gospel to surrounding areas.

feeds.title: Carmelite spirituality and the practice of mental prayer
feeds.description: This blog is to propagate genuine Catholic devotions in the spirit of Traditional Carmel by providing texts useful for spiritual readings and meditations. The blog is lovingly dedicated to the Infant Jesus of Prague and under His Patronage. The palm and the lily signifies the first saints of the order: St. Angelus of Sicily (signified by the palm of martyrdom) and St. Albert of Trapani (signified by the lily).
